name: llm-qwen3-4b
description: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 read at the answer token. Zero-shot, no fine-tuning by this project. About 8 GB in half precision.

calibration.note: Fitted with training/calibrate.py on held-back rows of data/calib.jsonl (public gold-labelled tasks): choice and yes/no minimise negative log-likelihood, score minimises the error of the expected level.

summary: The best balance of speed and accuracy: 70% at about 0.18 s per request.
use_when: You want interactive speed with solid accuracy.
Most everyday triage: tickets, emails, comments, intents.
avoid_when: The hardest reasoning questions: it trails Qwen3.5-4B by 10 points, mostly on the hard tier.
Memory is tight: it needs about 8 GB.
